```esql
FROM books,books_english METADATA _index
| WHERE MATCH(title, "ring") AND book_no IN ("2714", "2936")
| SORT _index, book_no
| LIMIT 10
| HIGHLIGHT
| KEEP _index, book_no, highlight_title
```
